name: lab_crusher's pusher (internal/sim push.go): alice stands in its lane and the 2 m block crossing the floor at 4 m/s pushes her ahead of it, never inside it, to where it turns back (x 6.4: its face at the far end plus her radius), and leaves her there; bob stands just off the lane (his hull 1 cm clear of the block's side) and is never touched. Server and predictor agree every tick. (The movers' phase is each player's command clock: after more than a period, not at a tick.)
